description: Land Acquisition - Sumanathissagama, Badulla D/S Division, Badulla District (Section 05)
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular piece of land is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and location information. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), this is incidental to the primary purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition - a core land/property matter falling under Type 4 classification.
